Formula For every enabled range, live = live && value >= parameters[base] && value < parameters[base + 1]: half-open, so the maximum itself is excluded, and a NaN value never passes. A disabled range (parameters[base + 2] == 0) is skipped. The mask starts at 1 (or at the caller mask), so the result is the AND of all ranges; an edge slot is finally kept only when both of its endpoints are live, and dropIsolated also removes nodes left without a live slot. Integer and comparison arithmetic only, so the result is exact.
